logic_errors.issue: The redirect path calls location.assign(), then finally clears busy and submitting before the document navigation completes. If that navigation stalls, the old form remains usable and can submit another POST.
logic_errors.recommendation: Keep submission locked after handing off to navigation. Test with the destination document request delayed and verify that another submit cannot create another audit.

logic_errors.issue: Pending navigation protection covers dialog link clicks only. Browser Back, reload, or another document navigation can still discard the pending POST observation, recreating commit ambiguity.
logic_errors.recommendation: Add a pending-operation departure warning where browsers support it; use server-side idempotency if duplicate prevention must survive document departure.

suggestions.suggestion: The route holds the POST before it reaches Django, then verifies one audit after release. Add coverage for a committed POST whose response is lost, uncertain-outcome repeat blocking, fallback-link blocking, and delayed redirect navigation.

summary: Independently reviewed all staged changes and relevant staged authorization, CSRF, middleware, and privacy code. No introduced authorization bypass, cross-tenant disclosure, CSRF regression, or unsafe fallback URL was found. Close/Escape and concurrent-submit guards work during the fetch, but navigation lifecycle gaps remain. Static review only; tests were not executed. No files or git state were modified, and unstaged evidence was excluded.
